title: Shifted degree-zero right-derived comparison
statement: Let B be a Grothendieck abelian category and C an abelian category, both with derived categories, and let G : B → C be additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For n ∈ ℕ define a natural isomorphism H^n(RG(A[n])) ≅ G(A) by the single-functor shift isomorphism, RG shift compatibility, the homology shift isomorphism, the existing degree-zero derived identification [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], and R^0G ≅ G. This is an explicit composite of the existing isomorphisms, with no chosen existence witness.
